supply-chain.html.lead: This page says how Ordinance DS treats a file that comes from another project.

topics.title: A checksum
text: A checksum is a short value that is computed from a file. A changed file gives another value.

sbom.html.lead: This page explains the software bill of materials and links to the file.

topics.title: SBOM
text: SBOM is short for software bill of materials: a list of every component of a piece of software.
